scope: Five selected MGR PNGs only. Read-only image inspection and metrics; no image generation, image editing, retry of rejected requests, or Git mutation.

referenceBasis.locator: PDF page 3, printed pages 32–33, as recorded by the source handoff
referenceBasis.type: Official Piggyback guide equipment icons, supplied as local cropped raster references
referenceBasis.inspected: All five local icon crops and all five selected PNGs viewed individually with view_image.
limits: The supplied references are stylized, flat guide icons, not exported native models.
The original PDF was not reopened by this reviewer; source attribution and page locator follow the handoff.
No unseen rear geometry, physical scale, exact materials or interactive behavior can be validated from these icons.

overall.summary: All five images preserve the icon-level visual identity and show one complete object with comfortable margins. Fine colored edge traces and low-alpha residue remain; geometry and material choices are reconstructions.
commonLimitations: The painted worn-metal surfaces, bevels and highlights add detail not established by the flat guide icons.
Occasional fine cyan/blue or colored traces are visible at some silhouette edges at native inspection scale; these are not perfectly neutral cutouts.
Low-alpha residue includes isolated nonzero pixels near canvas edges. The visible objects do not touch the canvas at alpha >=16.
This review concerns the static asset only; no smoke, hologram, jamming field, projectile simulation, pickup logic, scale or combat binding is validated.

preserved: Squat circular grey housing viewed from above/front.
Radial vertical fins around the body and layered circular rim.
Yellow top disk with a large red cross and dark outline.
Front central angular seam and the overall ribbed silhouette.
deviations: Metal is substantially darker and more reflective, with scratches and bevels absent from the flat icon.
Fin thickness, ring depth and exact spacing are interpreted; the icon cannot certify a complete model.
A few fine cyan/blue traces are visible along the outside edge at native scale.
visual.limitation: Icon identity is clear; material finish and precise three-dimensional construction are not validated.

preserved: Squat grey ribbed circular housing matching the family of the Repair Nanopaste icon.
Cyan top disk.
Dark horizontal battery pictogram with white outline and right-side terminal shape.
Radial outer fins and central front angular seam.
deviations: Painted metal texture, thicker bevels and layered ring depth are reconstructed.
The cyan disk is more luminous and textured than the flat source icon.
Minor fine cyan/blue edge contamination remains in isolated places.
visual.limitation: Distinct from Repair Nanopaste through the correct top color and symbol; no native mesh or unseen sides validated.

preserved: Tall front-facing rectangular grey housing with broader upper and lower ends.
Central notch at the top and bottom; stepped side outline.
Orange rectangular display.
Large circular lower control and flanking grooves; upper L-shaped grooves.
deviations: Orange display has a brighter glowing perimeter and reflective treatment not established by the small source icon.
Bevel width, housing thickness, scratches and groove depth are interpreted.
Fine blue/cyan traces appear at portions of the outer top and lower edges.
visual.limitation: The physical frame is readable. No hologram is depicted or validated; this is not evidence of a functional distraction effect.

preserved: Tall grey cylindrical body with rounded shoulder and narrow neck.
Two lower horizontal bands and a subtle upper body seam.
Forward-leaning oval ring at the upper right and long right-side lever.
Plain grey body without added lettering, electronics or unrelated ornament.
deviations: Overall body appears slightly more elongated than the icon.
Ring, lever and top assembly are modeled with greater thickness and depth than the icon establishes.
Worn brushed-metal texture and highlights are reconstructed; a few fine colored edge pixels remain.
visual.limitation: Recognizable as the supplied RP icon; exact proportions, hidden assembly and any smoke/projectile behavior remain unverified.

preserved: Tall grey body with relatively straight sides and rounded lower corners.
Large dark repeating hexagonal pattern across the main face.
Narrow neck and forward oval ring at upper right.
Long right-side lever and restrained grey palette.
deviations: The hexagonal lattice is bolder and visually heavier than in the small source icon.
Shoulder, top assembly, ring thickness and side depth are reconstructed.
Scuffed metal finish is added; minor fine colored traces remain near parts of the silhouette.
visual.limitation: Hexagonal ornament distinguishes this asset from the RP body. Hidden faces, exact pattern continuation and jamming effects are not validated.
